# Coco's Inn Resort, Kashid

> Coco's Inn Resort is a coastal resort in Barshiv village, 2.6 km from Kashid Beach on the Alibaug–Murud coastal road (Tal. Murud, Dist. Raigad 402202, Maharashtra). It offers sea view rooms, Kokani dining, a swimming pool, and venues for events and weddings.

## Key facts
- Location: Barshive, Near Kashid Beach, Tal. Murud, Raigad, Maharashtra 402202
- Distance: 2.6 km from Kashid Beach
- Booking / WhatsApp: +91 91675 62668
- Email: admin@cocosinn.com
- Book online: https://bookingengine.stayflexi.com/?hotel_id=30260
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/cocos.inn.resort
